title: State recovery after constant renaming
statement: Let $S_1,S_2$ be state types, let $e\in S_1$, and let $d$ be a configuration whose state is the left injection of $e$ into the disjoint union $S_1\sqcup S_2$. First map every state to $e$, then map $e$ back through the left injection; the resulting configuration is exactly $d$.
hypotheses_covered: configuration $d$ with state equal to the left injection of $e$ into $S_1\sqcup S_2$
